title: Officials deny such a craft in inventory; Rogers says he saw it

tellings.quote: uh, some of the government officials said, "We have never had a craft like that in our inventory." And I was sitting there saying, "What are you talking about?" I saw it.

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who worked with NASA, says he saw an unexplained craft in a secret hangar, and that when government officials later said "We have never had a craft like that in our inventory," he knew it was false. "I was sitting there saying, 'What are you talking about?' I saw it," he tells Michels. If he is right, officials have publicly denied a craft the government actually holds.
